name: jev-router
description: Routes skills and models with TypeSafe Jev and supplies automatic assistant-owned typed decisions throughout a task

typesafe_api_key.title: General · TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for api.typesafe.ai. Stored in secure storage. The router stays off while it is empty.

enabled.title: General · Router enabled
enabled.description:
Turn skill selection, model routing and automatic decisions on or off without uninstalling the plugin.
Default: on

write_log.title: General · Write log
write_log.description:
Record each round and step to the plugin data folder. Prompt text and keys are never written.
Default: off

reset_to_defaults.title: General · Reset all settings to defaults
reset_to_defaults.description:
Turn on to restore every setting below. The API key is kept. The switch turns itself off.
Default: off

skill_routing.title: Skill · Skill selection (experimental)
skill_routing.description:
Experimental. Jev screens the skills for each prompt and the prompt carries the ones it kept; Claude Code still lists every skill itself, so this adds a hint rather than replacing the list. Off: no skill is suggested and the skill index is not built; model routing and automatic decisions are unaffected. The Router enabled switch stops all three.
Default: off

decision_routing.title: Decision · Automatic decisions
decision_routing.description:
Expose the decide tool and instruct Claude to send narrow assistant-owned decisions to api.typesafe.ai with relevant task evidence. User choices, preferences and authorization stay with the user. Each tool call makes a separate Jev request; no actions are executed by the tool.
Default: on

gate_threshold.title: Skill · Gate threshold
gate_threshold.description:
Two yes/no questions open the gate: does the request name a skill or workflow itself, and does a listed skill do what it asks. If neither is at least this likely, no skill is suggested.
Default: 0.5

fits_threshold.title: Skill · Fits threshold
fits_threshold.description:
Every shortlisted skill whose fit reaches this is suggested, with no count limit. In the logs, skills that clearly fit scored 0.69 and up and unrelated ones 0.4 and below.
Default: 0.5

skill_trim_hint.title: Skill · Remind me to trim the skill listing
skill_trim_hint.description: At each session start, say so while the skill listing is not trimmed (no description cap, or a project skill still in full), and name the command that trims it (/jev-skills opt). Nothing is written until you run it.\nDefault: on

chat_notice.title: General · Show choices in the conversation
chat_notice.description:
Add a line to the conversation, which you see and the model does not read, saying what Jev chose for each message: model and effort, skill, saved tool. The status line shows it too, where the host draws one.
Default: on

tool_routing.title: Tool · Tool selection (experimental)
tool_routing.description:
Experimental. Jev suggests a saved tool (a script an assistant wrote for earlier work) when a request looks like work it already did. Claude decides whether to run it; nothing runs by itself. Off: saved tools are neither asked about nor suggested.
Default: off

tool_save.title: Tool · Let Claude save tools
tool_save.description:
Expose the save_tool tool and tell Claude to save scripts it writes for repeatable work. Only a pointer, a description and how to run it are kept (never the file's content), in your own Claude data, not in the project. Manage them with /jev-tool.
Default: on

tool_threshold.title: Tool · Selection threshold
tool_threshold.description:
The best-fitting saved tool is suggested when Jev puts at least this probability on one of the saved tools doing what the request asks. Raise it to suggest fewer.
Default: 0.5

tool_save_threshold.title: Tool · Save threshold
tool_save_threshold.description:
A tool is saved only when Jev judges it at least this likely to serve other work, not just the task it was written for. 0 saves without asking Jev.
Default: 0.5

model_routing.title: Model · Model routing
model_routing.description:
off: never change the model. dry-run: log what Jev would send, change nothing. on: send each main request with the cheapest model and effort Jev judges able to do the work.
Default: dry-run

fallback_model.title: Model · Fallback model
fallback_model.description:
Used when Jev gives no answer (an error or a timeout). session: the model you chose with /model. The chat panel's model display never changes.
Default: session

feasibility_threshold.title: Model · Feasibility threshold
feasibility_threshold.description:
Jev judges each tier at each effort; a pair counts as able to do the work when Jev judges it at least this likely to complete it. The cheapest able pair runs (cache rebuild on a model switch and output included); pairs costing within a few percent of it compete on feasibility.
Default: 0.6

jev_context_enabled.title: Routing · Share recent context with Jev
jev_context_enabled.description:
Send bounded recent user/assistant excerpts to api.typesafe.ai with the existing classification call. Tool payloads and skill blocks are excluded; common credentials are redacted on a best-effort basis. Excerpts are never logged. Disable to send only the current prompt text.
Default: true
